title: Import Transactions
subtitle: Import transactions from a CSV or Excel file
addPageBanner: Have a transactions file? Import from CSV or Excel

prepare.title: Before You Import
prepare.description: Import transactions from a CSV or Excel spreadsheet in a few simple steps.
prepare.templateDescription: Download the sample spreadsheet — it has all the columns Ten10 recognises. Fill it in, upload it here, and the system will auto-map the columns so you can go straight to reviewing the rows.
prepare.privacyNote: File contents are processed locally in this session and are not saved before you approve.
prepare.toratMaaserUnsupported: Note: Ten10 does not currently support importing Excel spreadsheets from "Torat Maaser".
prepare.checklistTitle: Good to know before you start
prepare.checklistItem1: Your file is never uploaded to a server — parsing happens in the browser, and data is only saved after your final approval
prepare.checklistItem2: Nothing is saved until you review each row and approve it yourself
prepare.checklistItem3: Date and amount columns are required — everything else is optional
prepare.checklistItem4: Ten10 template available for download — not required, any CSV or XLSX with clear headers works
prepare.csvDesc: Any CSV file with column headers
prepare.ownFileHint: No template needed — if your file has clear column headers, Ten10 will try to map them automatically.

columns.title: Template Columns
columns.currency: Currency – defaults to your default currency if omitted

prepare.mappingDescription: In the next step you will link each column from your file to a Ten10 field. Date and Amount are required.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.dropzone: Drop your file here, or click to upload

errors.tooManyRows: File has too many rows (max {{rows}} rows)
errors.xlsNotSupported: .xls files are not supported. Please save as .xlsx
errors.parseError: Could not read the file. Make sure it is a valid CSV or Excel file.
errors.parseTimeout: Reading the file took too long. Try again, or save the sheet as a new file and upload it again.
errors.noData: The file has no data rows
errors.suspiciousHeaders: The first row looks like transaction data, not column headers. Add a header row and try again.
errors.tooManyFiles: Upload one file at a time

sheetSelect.title: Select Sheet
sheetSelect.description: This workbook has multiple sheets. Select the one to import.

mapping.title: Map Columns
mapping.description: Link each column from your file to a Ten10 field. Columns marked with * are required.
mapping.whatIsMapping: Tell TEN10 which column is the date, the amount and the description. We've guessed already; mark anything you don't need as "Don't import".
mapping.ten10TemplateDetected: This is the TEN10 template. Everything is matched, you can continue.

errors.dateMissing: Date is missing. Choose which column is the transaction date.
errors.amountMissing: Amount is missing. Choose "Amount", or "Debit" and "Credit" if your bank splits them.
errors.duplicateTarget: {{columns}} are both set to {{field}}. Keep one and set the other to "Don't import".
errors.duplicateTargetInline: {{other}} is also set to {{field}}. Keep one and set the other to "Don't import".
errors.amountAndDebitCredit: Pick one method: a single "Amount" column, or "Debit" and "Credit". Not both.
errors.amountAndDebitCreditInline: There's already an "Amount" or "Debit/Credit" column. Pick one method.
errors.generic: There's a problem with the column matching. Check the marked rows.

diagnostics.empty_headers: {{count}} columns have no header and will be skipped
diagnostics.many_unmapped_columns: {{count}} columns won't be imported. Check nothing important is missing.
diagnostics.multiple_description_candidates: Several description columns were found: {{columns}}. You can map more than one to Description.
diagnostics.amount_debit_credit_columns: Found both "Amount" and "Debit/Credit". Pick one method.
diagnostics.generated_headers: No header row found, so we named the columns. Choose by the samples.

mapping.detectedCount_one: We matched 1 column for you. Glance at the samples to check.
mapping.detectedCount_other: We matched {{count}} columns for you. Glance at the samples to check.

help.title: What is column matching?
help.definition: You tell TEN10 what each column in your file holds: which is the date, the amount and the description.
help.date: Date ← the day the money moved
help.amount: Amount ← how much. If your bank splits it, "Debit" and "Credit"
help.description: Description ← the business name or details
help.rule: Only date and amount are required. Everything else can be "Don't import".
help.example1: "Value date" ← Date. Also have "Date"? Keep one; set the other to "Don't import".
help.example3: "Balance" ← Don't import (a balance isn't a transaction)

importing.loadingDescription: Writing approved rows to your account.

codes.recurring_fetch_failed: We could not check recurring transaction matches. Try again.

review.noRows: No rows match the current filter.

confirm.description_other: You are about to import {{count}} transactions.
